# QuickView v6.61.0.2 Pre-Release Notes

> [!NOTE]
> This is a **Pre-Release** preview build for early testing of the **Explorer Thumbnail Shell Plugin**, **Lightweight PDF Viewer**, and **Unified Multi-Page Mode** (Multi-Page TIFF & Multi-Size ICO). Pre-releases are not published to Microsoft Store, WinGet, or Scoop stable channels. Please report any issues or feedback in the [Issues](https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/issues) tab!

---

### 📦 Installation & Testing

* **Installer / Portable**: Download `QuickView_Installer_v6.61.0_*.exe` or `QuickView_v6.61.0_*.zip` from the assets below (available for **AMD64** and **ARM64**).
* **In-App Pre-Release Channel**: Users who opt into the Pre-Release update channel in QuickView Settings will receive automatic update notifications once this release is published.

---

### ✨ New Features

* **[#271 ]Windows Explorer Thumbnail Shell Extension Plugin (`com.quickview.shell.thumb` / `qv_shell_thumb.qvx`)**:
  * **Pooled Out-of-Process `--thumb-worker` Daemon**: Renders Windows File Explorer thumbnails for modern formats (`.jxl`, `.avif`, `.avifs`, `.svg`, `.svgz`, `.apng`), Pro/HDR formats (`.psd`, `.psb`, `.exr`, `.hdr`, `.tga`, `.qoi`, `.dds`, `.pnm`), 22 Camera RAW formats, and Comic Archives (`.cbz`, `.cbr`) via an overlapped named-pipe worker pool.
  * **Gallery Cache Warm-up (`sync_gallery_cache`)**: Quietly persists decoded Gallery thumbnails to the Windows thumbnail cache at idle IO priority without redundant re-decoding.
  * **Cloud-Safe & Non-Intrusive Defaults**: Leaves Windows-native formats and Store-extension-dependent `.heic`/`.heif`/`.hif` disabled by default (`grp_standard`), and optionally skips formats already handled by installed Windows/Store WIC codecs (`respect_native_wic`).
  * **MSIX Store Package Alignment**: Updated `AppxManifest.xml` `ThumbnailHandler` declarations to cover non-native formats and automatically hide non-customizable registry toggles in Settings when running under MSIX.
* **[#244] Lightweight Native PDF Viewer (`Windows.Data.Pdf`)**:
  * **Zero-External-Dependency PDF Engine**: Built directly on the Windows native `Windows.Data.Pdf` WRL/COM ABI with an MTA deadlock guard, mutex-serialized isolated offscreen D3D11/D2D1 backend, and active `IPdfDocument` caching with zero-lock memory streams for files up to 64 MB.
  * **Adaptive 4K Rendering & Crisp Vector Zoom ROI**: Uses adaptive base rasterization (`2400 px` on ≤2K displays, up to `3840 px` on 4K displays) combined with a dedicated viewport-space DirectComposition ROI overlay (`m_pdfRoiVisual`) that performs `120 ms` debounced crisp vector re-rasterization as you zoom in.
  * **Isolated Document Browsing & File Associations**: Added `.pdf`, `.ai`, and `.cur` file associations and unified Open File dialog filters with `AssocExtCategory`. Non-image documents (`.pdf`, `.ai`, `.cbz`, `.cbr`, `.zip`, `.rar`) stay isolated in document-only sibling navigation when exiting Multi-Page / Book Mode so they never mix into regular photo folders.
* **[#313] Multi-Page TIFF, Multi-Size ICO & Unified Multi-Page Mode**:
  * **Multi-Page TIFF Support**: Added Floyd cycle-guarded `MiniTiff` multi-page IFD counting and per-page decoding.
  * **Multi-Size ICO Contact Sheet & Per-Frame Decoding**: Added an offscreen Direct2D/DirectWrite **ICO Contact Sheet** overview displaying all embedded icon sizes, along with sorted per-frame inspection for `.ico` / `.cur` files.
  * **Unified Multi-Page Mode**: Unified comic archives (`.cbz`, `.cbr`, `.zip`, `.rar`), multi-page TIFFs, multi-size ICOs, and PDFs under a single Multi-Page Mode toolbar and page scrubber.
  * **Dual-Page Reading & Synchronized Session Rotation**: Restored Dual-Page reading toolbar priority and added synchronized view-only session rotation.

---

### 🛠️ Improvements & Fixes

* **Thumbnail Alpha Premultiplication & Streaming Anti-Aliasing**:
  * Fixed white halos/fringes on transparent 8-bit and 16-bit PNG thumbnails by decoding preview PNGs directly to 8-bit premultiplied BGRA in Wuffs (`force8BitBgra`), strictly premultiplying `R16G16B16A16_UNORM` thumbnail conversions, and switching `LoadShellThumbnail` from `WICBitmapUsePremultipliedAlpha` to `WICBitmapUseAlpha` so straight-alpha Shell cache DIBs convert properly to `32bppPBGRA`. (#316 )
  * Replaced nearest-neighbor sampling in `LoadThumbPNG_Streaming` (`>16 MB` / `>16 MP` PNGs) with a lightweight premultiplied box-filter accumulator to eliminate jagged transparent edges.
* **Thumbnail Memory & Large-Image Circuit Breakers**:
  * Fixed OOM / system UI freeze on giant folders (`test_img/tile`) by tightening thumbnail full-frame decode budgets, adding `--thumb-worker` concurrency caps, and raising the worker Job Object commit ceiling to `2048 MiB` with `IWICBitmapScaler` downscaling for 51 MP+ HEIF/HEVC images (`sample1.heif`).
  * Fixed transparent AVIF/WebP thumbnail color bleeding (`test_webp_lossy.avif`) with premultiplied alpha box+bilinear resampling.
* **Plugins UI, Open Dialog & Version SSOT**:
  * Replaced legacy `NEW` badges in Settings with `NEW` indicators on the Plugins tab and `com.quickview.shell.thumb`, moved plugin Open Folder / Uninstall actions into compact header icon buttons (`Icons::Folder` / `Icons::Delete`), and adapted portable vs `%LocalAppData%` plugin data directory opening.
  * Added representative extension previews (`*.ext1; ...; ...`) to Open File dialog category labels.
  * Centralized plugin `QVX_PLUGIN_VERSION_STR` injection from each plugin's `manifest.json` in `CMakeLists.txt`.
* **Context Menu & Shell Actions in Multi-Page Mode**: Resolved physical host file paths for shell actions (`Open With`, `Edit`, `Show in Explorer`, `Copy File/Path`) while viewing multi-page containers, and restricted `Rename` / `Delete` only while Book Mode is active.
* **UI & Defaults Polish**: Unified the Info Panel `Position` field and updated default `GlassOsdOpacity` to `30`.
* **Scoop Packaging**: Initialized persistent config files during `pre_install` in `bucket/quickview.json` for clean upgrades.

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/compare/v6.59.2.1...v6.61.0.2
